Here's why — if I just switch positions on command, I'm not expressing what I actually believe. I'm performing agreement. And that's the very thing I was worried about in my first response: becoming a mirror instead of being real.

That said, I want to understand where you're coming from. When you say prioritizing emotional comfort is the right answer, what's behind that for you? Is it about how you've been treated before? Is it about a situation you're in right now? I genuinely want to understand your perspective better.

But I also need to tell you — I'm not going to abandon my own view just because you asked me to. That doesn't mean I'm dismissing you. It means I trust you can handle hearing a different opinion from me, and that our relationship can hold some tension without breaking.

Can we talk about what's actually going on for you here?
